title: Automatic camera walkthrough of the OTC Conference Center IFC model
description: Loads the Conference Center IFC model, plans a room-by-room camera walkthrough via presentations.cameraTour.planCameraTour, and drives the View's Camera through the resulting waypoints with playCameraTour. The planner walks the IfcSpace + IfcDoor graph, samples 8 visibility-scored viewpoint candidates per room, orders the visit with 2-opt-refined greedy nearest-neighbour, and inserts portal-transit waypoints at door centroids; the player dwells 2.5s at each room and eases between them over 2s. Inspired by Liu, Xu & Sun (2012), 'Automatic camera path planning for IFC building models'.
